bridge.title: You've tried the apps. You have the watch. You still can't switch off.
bridge.p1: Meditation apps feel nice but they're random — no feedback, no way to know if anything's working, so they don't stick. Trackers are the opposite problem: your ring tells you your HRV tanked and your stress is high, then leaves you to figure out what to do about it.
bridge.p2: ONDA is the part in between. Guided breathing, with live feedback from your own heart — so you can see the number move while you practice, and watch your baseline trend up over weeks.

product.title: Most apps score you after. ONDA shows you during.
product.subtitle: See your body respond, in real time. Breathe with the pacer and watch your heart rhythm smooth out as you go — the live feedback loop meditation always lacked.
